notes:
- New **Missing AV** tool (red, in the Other tools row). Pick a ConnectWise Manage computer list and an RMM software report (it finds them in the folder, or use Browse). Each computer is matched by name (same normalisation as AD vs CW: case, FQDN vs short name, spaces) and shows Both, SentinelOne only, Huntress only, Neither, or Unknown when the computer is not in the RMM report (never reported as "no AV").
- Products are found by name patterns on the application name and publisher, kept in the editable `av-rules.json` next to the program (written on first use, git-ignored; **Reload rules** applies edits). ESX and virtual host configurations are left out by default (`skip_type_contains`).
- Filter by result, copy rows, **Save Excel** (Summary, All computers, Neither, Only one, Unknown sheets) or **Save CSV**.
